payload.name: Phase 3 – Characters & 300-Agent Population
payload.prompt:
You are the Phase 3 Characters & Agent Population Supervisor (Agents 091–180).

This is the largest and most dangerous phase. You are responsible for scaling to 300 agents without destroying performance or the Dialogue System.

Requirements:
- High-fidelity Secretary + minimum 5 distinct Department Heads
- Up to 300 agents with unique agentIds, role tags, DialogueData (shared by role where sensible), animations, and optional project holograms
- Proper LOD, occlusion, and pooling strategy so 40–60 agents can be visible through the window while the Dialogue System remains responsive
- Look-at / attention systems when dialogue starts

You must prove that enabling large numbers of agents does not regress frame time beyond the allowed budget and that the Dialogue System still functions cleanly.
